Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Reorder Sign-In After Pet Customization: Move sign-in step after pick_friend and upload_photos so users select and customize their pet before being asked to create an account. (why: Adoption step drops ~37% of users and sign_in drops 27%; letting users build emotional investment in their pet first boosts account creation intent.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Interactive Desktop Controls Guide Screen: Insert a short interactive guide screen before home completion demonstrating how to right-click, hide, drag, and talk to your pet. (why: Support mail showed multiple tickets about confusion over controlling, hiding, or chatting with pets post-onboarding.)
2: [home, new_flow] Interactive Waiting Screen Experience Flow: Rebuild the waiting screen into a spotlight layout with progress indicators and dynamic tip carousels during pet generation. (why: The waiting stage takes a mean of 2336s with an 81.3% pass rate; providing active tips and feedback reduces drop-off during long renders.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Cloud Save Account Sync Reminder Hint: Add an explicit guarantee hint on the sign-in screen explaining that signing in prevents pet loss or reset across sessions. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding lost or reset pets after signing back in.)
4: [adoption, wait_info] Photo Upload Best Practices Checklist: Add photo quality guidance checklist directly to the photo upload screen to ensure successful AI pet generation. (why: 3 support tickets specifically noted custom pet generation failures or distorted pet visuals.)
5: [finish, layout] Pet Visibility Shortcut Test Banner: Add a desktop summon test component and visibility troubleshoot prompt on home_intro. (why: 3 support tickets reported pets failing to appear on desktop or app launch issues.)
6: [choose_path, layout] Story Scroll Welcome Screen Refresher: Change story screen layout to story_scroll with a playful mascot hero visual. (why: High mean elapsed time at early onboarding stages indicates low visual engagement.)
